notes.title: Juice the Moose Update
notes.content:
Since Moosleutions got into both MAGFest and the Turn-Based Carnvial sale, I thought it would be nice to improve upon some areas of the game that I found lacking.

The main thrust of the update has been the desire to add more "juice" to the game, to make it feel more lively.

With that goal in mind, this recent update includes the following juicy bits:
- A totally new set of player animations
- A camera shake effect when the moose hit obstacles in the terrain
- A particle effect when the moose charge through grass and leaves
- A particle effect when the moose hit trees
- A bright new summer theme

If you haven't purchased Mooselutions yet, don't buy it right now. Wait for the Turn-Based Carnival of the Steam fall sale, which we will be participating in.

notes.title: Navigation Redesign
notes.content:
Hi folks,

I just finished the last update for a little while. It contains a few often requested quality of life improvements.

1. The menus are redesigned. Now you can access the menu from inside of a level and from the world map.

2. World map access from the main menu. If you are in a puzzle, you can go to the main menu to access the world map. (Note: you can also access the world map at any time by pressing 'M' on the keyboard or 'X' on most game controllers).

3. Volume controls follow a logarithmic pattern for additional precision.

4. A bunch of tiny improvements to the way the menus and world map feel when you use them.

I have a major surgery next week (don't worry, I will be totally fine), and it will require a short hospitalization. If you have any questions at all during this time, please head over to the game's Discord, and my friends will help you out.

Thanks so much for playing and for your overwhelmingly positive support. I feel so lucky to have given you this game.

notes.title: First post-launch update
notes.content:
Hi folks,

The first official update for Mooselutions addresses the following:

1.) Trying to enter a level while moving on the world map loads the level where you were, not the level you're going to. This was fixed by simply preventing the player from entering a level while walking on the map.

2.) There was an occasional crash that could get triggered by undoing in the middle of a long moose charge. It had to do with animation state machines not being reset at the time of the undo.

3.) One of the winter puzzles wasn't constrained enough and was easily cheesed. The update adds a constraint that prevents the cheese from being an allowable Mooselution.

4.) Restart is now non-destructive. It is considered "just another move," which means you can now rewind past your restart to the state before the restart.
